T:P1.1.text: Logistics Services and Freight Shipping | J.B. Hunt

T:P1.2.text: Our mode-neutral shipping solutions make moving freight easy. We're creating the most efficient transportation network in North America.

T:P1.3.text: Read our latest white paper: Structural Forces Reshaping the Freight Market

T:P1.4.text: Change the way you do business with the J.B. Hunt 360 °® platform. We're eliminating inefficiencies by creating one place for you to manage every step of the transportation process.

T:P1.6.text: Access to thousands of qualified carriers

T:P1.7.text: Take advantage of the cost-effective and sustainable solutions from North America’s leading intermodal provider.

T:P1.8.text: Move over-the-road shipments with flexibility and efficiency through our J.B. Hunt 360box® drop-and-hook solution.

T:P1.9.text: Receive access to nationwide reach, visibility into performance, streamline shipments and more with less-than-truckload (LTL).

T:P1.10.text: Get best-in-class safety, route planning and optimization capabilities for your dedicated fleet when you work with J.B. Hunt teams.

T:P1.11.text: We’ve got you covered from the first mile all the way through last-mile deliveries to homes and job sites.

T:P1.12.text: Get customized support, supply chain visibility and seamless transloading service with over-the-road and rail options available.

T:P1.13.text: Get a provider that creates a custom supply chain for your business and handles the day-to-day operations for you.

T:P1.14.text: Get the capacity you need for your over-the-road freight, supported by thousands of qualified third-party carriers.

T:P1.15.text: That's why we have a passionate pursuit of excellence and are always striving for more. We listen, innovate and invest in order to provide you with excellence. J.B. Hunt is driven for you.

T:P1.16.text: "Technology in the global transportation space to me means real-time visibility and the 360 platform does a very nice job of providing that for me."

T:P1.17.text: Director of Global Transportation and Trade Compliance at a global fishing company

T:P1.18.text: "J.B. Hunt takes the time up front to really get to know our business, our pain points and then customize a tailored solution to meet those."

T:P1.19.text: Chief Executive Officer for a wholesale hardware and industrial supplies distributor

T:P2.1.text: Our Company | Creating Transportation Efficiency | J.B. Hunt

T:P2.2.text: J.B. Hunt provides a variety of freight transportation services to customers throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

T:P2.3.text: We got our start with five trucks, seven trailers and Mr. Hunt’s vision to create something big. We’ve grown a lot but our legacy of innovation and impact lives on. Together, we’re working toward our vision to create the most efficient transportation network in North America.

T:P2.4.text: "To get where we’re gonna go, it takes all of us. I can’t do it, you can’t do it, but we can do that."

T:P2.5.text: Our vision is to create the most efficient transportation network in North America. This statement keeps us focused on the future and what we’re aspiring for as a company. It encourages us to not only innovate solutions that make our company better, but to find ways to improve the greater supply chain.

C:P1.2.text: At FreightCar America, our team, facility and wide variety of freight car offerings are purpose-built, tailored to meet your unique needs. Every railcar is manufactured and designed to the highest standards—and backed by industry-leading experts who provide comprehensive field support and training. We ensure that every railcar is a product of deep collaboration, ingenuity and an unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction.

C:P1.3.text: At FreightCar America, we deliver top-tier railcar products, innovative engineering and strong industry relationships. At FreightCar America, excellence isn’t just a goal—it’s our promise.

C:P1.4.text: At FreightCar America, we specialize in premium railcars, conversions, rebodies and exceptional parts and service. By actively listening and learning, we consistently exceed your railcar needs, delivering reliable solutions with every interaction. Choose FreightCar America for unmatched excellence and dependability.

C:P1.5.text: We design and manufacture durable steel, stainless steel, aluminum and hybrid steel-aluminum freight cars for a wide range of bulk commodities and containerized freight. Our expert team collaborates with you to deliver tailored railcar solutions. With a state-of-the-art facility, we produce over 20 conversion designs and an expanded portfolio, including open-top hoppers, covered hoppers, gondolas, flats, intermodal cars, boxcars and well cars (articulated and standalone).

C:P1.6.text: FreightCar America is the leader in rebuilding and repurposing freight car assets. From complete car rebodies to transforming unused railcars into the latest designs, FreightCar America delivers customer-focused solutions.

C:P1.7.text: Get the railcar parts you need from one reliable and knowledgeable source. We have a large, in-stock inventory of high-quality forged, cast and fabricated parts for all freight car types, regardless of the original builder.

C:P1.8.text: When you purchase a FreightCar America railcar, the experience doesn’t end after your railcar is delivered. FreightCar America provides a Standard Repair Procedures resource library.

C:P1.9.text: Our commitment to quality and customer service begins with the first customer contact and extends through the life of the railcar. Our customer service department is staffed by a highly qualified and experienced team with the resources to help with any of your service requirements.

C:P2.2.text: The newest, purpose-built railcar plant in the world. Welcome to the FreightCar America Castaños, Mexico plant.

C:P2.3.text: As a Pure Play manufacturer, we focus on what we do best—building railcars. This dedication to our craft inspires us to collaborate with our customers, lessors, and suppliers to deliver tailored solutions.

C:P2.4.text: FreightCar America designs and manufactures steel, stainless steel, aluminum and hybrid steel-aluminum freight cars that transport a wide variety of bulk commodities, containerized freight and other products. Our experienced team works closely with you to create customized railcar solutions for all your needs.

C:P2.5.text: As FreightCar America celebrates 125 years, we remain the only railcar manufacturer with a legacy of producing cars that have performed across hundreds of millions of miles. With our meticulous craftsmanship, proprietary welding process and quality control procedures, we proudly deliver durable, high-performance railcars that meet or exceed industry standards. FreightCar America has an unwavering commitment to structural integrity and excellence in every aspect of railcar manufacturing.
